description:
**Divergence**: the workspace has zero version-string skew (verified via `cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1`). However, four dev-deps that appear in 2 or more crates are declared inline with byte-identical specs each time, when the workspace root [workspace.dependencies] table would be the canonical home.

| Dep | Inline callers | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| wiremock | 9 crates — all 8 extension-client crates + jmap-base-client | `"0.6"` (no features) |
| criterion | 3 crates — jmap-mime, jmap-server, jmap-base-client | `{ version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["cargo_bench_support"] }` |
| tracing | 2 crates — jmap-base-client, jmap-metadata-server | `"0.1"` (dev-only, both) |
| tracing-subscriber | 2 crates — same as tracing | `{ version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["fmt"] }` (dev-only) |

**Caller-observable / maintainer effect**: zero runtime impact today (Cargo's unification produces the same resolved tree). But:
- Future version bumps require N file edits instead of 1.
- A contributor adding a new client crate has to know the wiremock spec by precedent (read another sibling's Cargo.toml) instead of writing `wiremock = { workspace = true }`.
- The tracing / tracing-subscriber pair is the secret-redaction-canary harness from the workspace AGENTS.md 'Security testing' section. The canary pattern is workspace policy; the deps should be workspace-shared by default so the next crate that adds a canary discovers them automatically.

**Fix**: append four lines to the workspace-root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]:

  wiremock = "0.6"
  criterion = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["cargo_bench_support"] }
  tracing = "0.1"
  tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["fmt"] }

…then rewrite the inline specs in the 9+3+2+2 = 16 call sites to `<dep> = { workspace = true }`. No behavior change at build time. Single sweep PR.

**Verification expected after the change**: `cargo build --workspace` and `cargo test --workspace` produce byte-identical artifacts; `cargo tree --workspace` shows the same dep tree.

**Cross-references**: bd:JMAP-ops7.13 (serde dep declaration consistency, closed) — same dep-management consistency axis. This bead is the dev-deps continuation of that workspace-deps tidy.
title: Workspace: hoist wiremock + criterion + tracing + tracing-subscriber to [workspace.dependencies] — 4 dev-deps declared inline in 9 / 3 / 2 / 2 crates respectively, no version skew but redundant per-crate specs
